errors.evidence: This phrase is ambiguous because while the solid lines themselves do not have markers directly on them, the chart prominently features circular markers (dots) for each color-coded series. Stating the lines are 'without visible markers' could be confusing as it ignores the presence of the dotted series which act as markers or trendlines.
